title: The moon could turn astronauts into 'walking, high voltage capacitors' that accidentally zap spacecraft
caption:
NASA is launching a challenge to solve a shocking problem: static electricity on the moon. Astronauts risk becoming walking capacitors that could zap their own spacecraft upon reentry. We need a way to safely ground them before they head back inside.
